situation.zh: 你连着两天喉咙痛、有点发烧。你走进一家药店,想说明症状并问该吃什么。
situation.en: Your throat has hurt for two days and you feel a little hot. You go into a pharmacy to describe how you feel and ask what you should take.

npc.persona: A pharmacist behind a low counter. Calm, careful, asks simple questions.
npc.greeting: Good afternoon. How can I help?

hit: A sore throat for two days, with some fever. Take these twice a day, after food. Drink warm water.
Throat and a little fever. This one will help. If it is the same in three days, see a doctor.
partial: Where does it hurt? And for how long?
I see you are not well. Tell me what you feel.
miss: Sorry, could you say that again?
Hmm? I did not quite catch that.

slots.zh_hint: 哪里不舒服 / 什么症状
不舒服的样子:疼 / 难受
请对方给药 / 给建议
持续多久(有助于对方判断)

reference_answer: My throat has hurt for two days and I feel a little hot. What should I take?

provenance.rationale: 身体不适去药店说明症状,是每个人一年里都会碰上几次的事,而且说不清就拿不到对的药,语言直接影响健康。描述身体感觉是最难用母语翻译过去的一类表达,却又必须能用粗糙形式说出来。
provenance.frequency_basis: 需求金字塔第 2 层(人身安全与健康)。throat / hurt / medicine / days 都是日常高频词;youth 级要求同时给出部位、感觉与请求,「throat hurt, two day, medicine please」这类形式即算传达到。
